nonclaims: Particle weights and reconciled weights are planner attention, not calibrated probabilities or truth certificates.
Lacuna verifies factor authority, complete custody, and arithmetic, not whether an authored likelihood assessment is semantically wise.
Active versus ended assertion state supplies a deterministic factor disposition but does not prove epistemic validity or invalidity.
Single-use assertion IDs do not establish independence among correlated, derivative, or paraphrased evidence.
Rev0153 cannot yet replace a mistaken likelihood vector through explicit predecessor/successor factor lineage or port factors across structural epochs.
Zero baseline mass or zero included likelihood remains absorbing; no diversity floor or extinction-recovery policy is bundled.
Log-space replay reduces ordinary underflow but still uses IEEE-754 doubles and is not an arbitrary-precision wire standard.
Reconciliation does not propose, resample, prune, merge, split, select, anchor, disclose, or canonize worlds.
The local event chain is not a digital signature, trusted timestamp, transparency service, or hostile-host non-equivocation guarantee.
No LLM vendor, dramatic scorer, semantic prose checker, external witness, or MCP transport is bundled.
